title: DailySalesSummary
description: Confirmed daily sales of one branch, broken down by product category. One message per (branchCode, saleDate, revision).

eventId.description: Unique per message. Used for tracing, not for deduplication.

branchCode.description: Must exist in the HQ branch registry.

saleDate.description: Business date in Asia/Bangkok local time.

revision.description: Starts at 1 and increases by 1 each time the branch re-confirms after an edit.

totalAmount.description: Must equal the sum of lines[].amount.

lines.description: categoryCode must be unique within one message.

money.description: Non-negative decimal string with exactly 2 decimal places. Parse as BigDecimal, never as floating point.

categoryCode.description: HQ standard category code. Must exist in the HQ category master. See categories.md.

quantity.description: Number of items sold in this category.
